_comment: Prices are supplied and dated by the author; null = not supplied, and the price-dependent columns of cost_breakeven.csv stay empty (the price-free break-even ratios are always computed). Units: currency per runner minute, per GB-month of registry storage, per GB downloaded from / uploaded to the registry. builds_per_month = number of builds sharing one stored cache per month (storage share of one build = 1 / builds_per_month). Add one object per public price list to compare.
